map.1: [Mr Mordaut]	Five Ages. Years of conflict and learning, and our collective culture gives us cheese. Down a hill.
map.2: [Thok]	Cheese rolling is Thok's favourite! CHEESE ROLL - CHEESE ROLL - CHEESE ROLL.
map.11: [Troll]	Cheese is rubbish. Milk is better.
map.12: [Tentacle]	You're not meant to troll the cheese, you're meant to roll the cheese!
map.21: [Troll]	Look! Cheese roll much better when it in a circle...
map.22: [Tentacle]	You are kidding me. Are you saying that trolls haven't invented the wheel yet?
map.23: [Troll]	Troll can think of many uses for it!
map.24: [Troll]	After games, Troll go back and tell friends about dis 'wheel'.
map.31: [Mr Mordaut]	You a fan of cheese, Zombie? You kick back in the evening with some cheese and crackers?
map.33: [Mr Mordaut]	Interesting. Were they moreish? A bit 'Oooh, just one more brain'.
map.41: [Raptor]	I refuse to be here while someone rolls cheese.
map.42: [Thok]	Why, Raptor? Bad history with cheese?
map.44: [Thok]	Eat too much cheese and have bad Raptor nightmare?
map.45: [Raptor]	If you'll excuse me, I have strykewyrms to kill.
map.51: [Mr Mordaut]	This reminds me of a joke. What did mother bear scream at baby bear when he was running in a cheese rolling race?
